_comment: Golden set for the retrieval regression gate (T4.4).
Answerable cases name the document that holds the answer and a distinctive
substring that must appear in a retrieved chunk. `evidence` is matched
case-insensitively against the chunk text, never against a generated answer:
TESTING.md §7 excludes model wording from the gate, and retrieval is the
Unanswerable cases assert the ADR-003 floor rejects them, which is what
stops the system hallucinating on out-of-scope questions.
